prisma: pack name, the Prisma schema language
provider: Prisma schema: datasource key naming the database
model: Prisma schema: block keyword declaring a model
view: Prisma schema: block keyword declaring a view
datasource: Prisma schema: block keyword declaring the database
id: Prisma schema: field attribute marking the primary key
unique: Prisma schema: field attribute marking a unique column
index: Prisma schema: block attribute declaring an index
name: Prisma schema: attribute argument naming the target
library: suss: marker for a value a library states
exhaustive: suss: a storage contract that declares every field
